label: id
comment: A unique identifier (URI) assigned to the product passport. May be a UUID
The globally unique ID of the product as a URI. Ideally as a resolvable URL according to ISO 18975.
A unique identifier for the declaration. Often this will be an extension of the product.id or attestation.id. But could be a UUID.

domainIncludes.comment: The Product Passport is a comprehensive data structure that encapsulates various details pertaining to a product, including its identification details, who issued it, batch information, provenance information, circularity information and a set of verifiable product conformity & sustainability claims.
The ProductInformation class encapsulates detailed information regarding a specific product, including its identification details, manufacturer, and other pertinent details.
A declaration of conformance with one or more criteria from a specific standard or regulation.
